scope: Euler equations and transversality conditions: sufficiency for catching-up optimality in a general vector space from supergradients, the Euler equation and transversality (Stokey-Lucas Thm 4.15) with no differentiability or interiority; the one-sector growth model with concave utility and technology: sufficiency, optimality of the modified-golden-rule steady state, necessity of the transversality condition by Kamihigashi's rescaling argument, an Euler path optimal iff it satisfies transversality, and a linear example in which a path satisfying the Euler equation but not transversality is not optimal.
source: Stokey and Lucas (1989), Thm 4.15; Ekeland and Scheinkman (1986); Kamihigashi (2001); Cass (1965); Koopmans (1965).
